name: Kaervek
description: Kaervek is a black-aligned human warlock from Dominaria, the main antagonist of the Mirage block, who tried to conquer Jamuraa.

description_citations.text: "Kaervek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
Mirage: card flavor text (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Kaervek is a black-aligned human warlock from Dominaria, the main antagonist of the Mirage block, who tried to conquer Jamuraa.

citations.text: "Kaervek". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
Mirage: card flavor text (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: He met Mangara and Jolrael on Teferi's Isle, allied with Jolrael, persuaded her that Mangara meant to conquer the continent, and trapped Mangara in an Amber Prison.

bio.text: He summoned the Spirit of the Night, which slaughtered the Council of Voices in Tulumai, and his armies crippled Ufunguo before a magical trap destroyed his army at Tefemburu.

"Mirage War", section "The Cost of Hope". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

"Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: When Oko could not pay him, Kaervek warned of dire consequences if Jace and Vraska were not found.

citations.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: Kaervek is alive and free; his last appearance has him warning Oko of dire consequences after the vault heist, with the crew disbanded.

citations.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek asks Shauku to aid his conquest of Jamuraa; she declines.
timeline.quote: she was approached by Kaervek to aid him in his conquest of Jamuraa , but she declined.

citation.text: "Shauku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek claims he has taken Mangara's power.
timeline.quote: "Mangara is gone. Who among you doubts that I have taken his power?"

citation.text: Disempower (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sidar Jabari warns Kaervek that Suq'Ata, Femeref and Zhalfirins are now joined.
timeline.quote: "Suq'Ata believe in trade; Femeref, alms; Zhalfirins, steel. Be warned, Kaervek—now we are joined."

citation.text: Divine Offering (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hakim recalls Zhalfir's dominance and Kaervek's shocking invasion.
timeline.quote: Kaervek's invasion shocked us all."

citation.text: Ancestral Memories (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek says night stalkers of Urborg are willing tools in plundering Femeref.
timeline.quote: Their sad eagerness to elevate themselves makes them willing tools in the plundering of little Femeref."

citation.text: Feral Shadow (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek declares Jamuraa will look to him alone as leader.
timeline.quote: Jamuraa will look to only one leader: me."

citation.text: Reign of Chaos (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek foretells that his victims' memory will fade.
timeline.quote: "The memory of your existence will fade like the final stars of morning."

citation.text: Psychic Transfer (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek sells secrets of Phyrexia at a steep price.
timeline.quote: "The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."

citation.text: Phyrexian Vault (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek vows to build walls from his enemies' flesh.
timeline.quote: "I shall make walls of their flesh, and their blood will be my mortar."

citation.text: Wall of Corpses (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek says he will stop life since he cannot stop death.
timeline.quote: "Since I cannot stop death, I choose to stop life."

citation.text: Soul Rend (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Mangara vanishes, Zhalfir, Femeref and Suq'Ata unite against Kaervek, who is first aided by the deceived Jolrael.
timeline.quote: Zhalfir, Femeref, and Suq-Ata united against the evil wizard Kaervek after the vanishing of Mangara.

citation.text: "Jamuraa", section "The Mirage Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek sails to the Chaza Isles to investigate an energy surge and meets Mangara and Jolrael.
timeline.quote: He did meet with two other people who had been attracted by the energy surge

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek allies with Jolrael, persuades her that Mangara means to conquer the continent, and starts a war; he traps Mangara in an Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Kaervek managed to trap Mangara in an Amber Prison

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek wages a long war with his allies, then attacks Teferi's isle; Jolrael ambushes him and Teferi sinks his fleet.
timeline.quote: After Teferi sank his fleet, Kaervek managed to escape to the Uuserk Marshes.

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mangara is freed, defeats Kaervek and locks him in the amber prison.
timeline.quote: Mangara then defeated Kaervek and locked him inside the amber prison himself

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mangara arrives in Jamuraa after meeting Jolrael and Kaervek and brokers peace among the nations, settling the Zhalfir-Femeref border with a buffer zone of Quirion Elves.
timeline.quote: Mangara brokered peace between the rival nations

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek resents the peace and persuades Jolrael that Mangara plans domination, sowing discord.
timeline.quote: he convinced her that Mangara's rule was but a prelude to domination

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek instigates skirmishes, then he and Jolrael ambush Mangara and seal him in an Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed Mangara, sealing him within an Amber Prison

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Mangara gone, the peace unravels and Kaervek's forces plunge the nations into the Mirage War.
timeline.quote: plunging the once-thriving nations into the Mirage War

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mangara, Jolrael and Kaervek meet on the barren rock that was Teferi's Isle and settle in Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: The three mages met on the barren rock that had once been Teferi's Isle.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Coming of Harmony". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek draws the reclusive Jolrael into regional politics and they build covert armies.
timeline.quote: Slowly, as Mangara's rule took shape, Kaervek was able to draw the reclusive Jolrael into the politics of the region.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Serpent in Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek and Jolrael ambush Mangara in the Mwonvuli Delta and imprison him in amber.
timeline.quote: Kaervek and Jolrael ambushed him, capturing him within an Amber Prison that now sits in the throne room of one of Jolrael's palaces.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Serpent in Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek reveals himself at the great council and demands the nations' surrender; they defy him.
timeline.quote: It was then that Kaervek chose to make his appearance, demanding the surrender of the three nations.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Serpent in Paradise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek manipulates Jolrael, imprisons Mangara in an Amber Prison and declares war on the three nations.
timeline.quote: After imprisoning Mangara in an Amber Prison , they declared war on the three nations.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi sinks Kaervek's armada and sends a drake to rescue Jolrael.
timeline.quote: Teferi finally intervened, sinking Kaervek's armada and sending a drake to rescue Jolrael.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "The Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek threatens a victim with his pet mindsucker.
timeline.quote: "My pet will pick the ripe fruit from your tortured brain as if it were hanging from a vine."

citation.text: Urborg Mindsucker (Multiverse Gift Box, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek declares blood on his hands is proof of his ambition.
timeline.quote: "The blood on my hands is merely proof of my ambition."

citation.text: Wicked Reward (Multiverse Gift Box, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy and taints Jamuraa out of spite.
timeline.quote: "Kaervek imprisoned Mangara out of jealousy, but he taints Jamuraa simply out of spite."

citation.text: Blanket of Night (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara confronts Kaervek's arrogance.
timeline.quote: "Your arrogance amazes me, Kaervek. Did you not know the price you would pay?"

citation.text: Aku Djinn (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi predicts Kaervek's coming demise.
timeline.quote: in truth, they mourn aloud for his impending demise."

citation.text: Shrieking Drake (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek says killing the land destroys the future.
timeline.quote: "Kill a creature, destroy the present. Kill the land, destroy the future."

citation.text: Desolation (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek says he would rule the dead.
timeline.quote: What do I care if I rule over the dead rather than over the living?

citation.text: Kaervek's Spite (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jolrael foresees betrayal of Kaervek or Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: "I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."

citation.text: Nekrataal (Visions, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek's armies cripple Ufunguo and Sidar Mwigo martyrs herself so citizens can escape.
timeline.quote: The attack crippled the city; only the martyrdom of Sidar Mwigo and her troops allowed the citizens to escape.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Dreaming of Victory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A magical trap destroys Tefemburu and Kaervek's armies.
timeline.quote: The trap sprang - a sphere of crackling energy enclosed Tefemburu and exploded, destroying the city and Kaervek's armies.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Dreaming of Victory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek sails to Teferi's Isle, where Teferi destroys his armada and Jolrael turns on him.
timeline.quote: During the battle, Jolrael turned upon Kaervek, severely injuring the mage in a heated arcane battle.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "Shocking Visions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jolrael regrets feeding Kaervek's hunger for power.
timeline.quote: "I regret feeding Kaervek's hunger for power—far better to live with animals innocent of such ambitions."

citation.text: Spirit Link (Fifth Edition, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mangara defeats Kaervek and seals him in the Amber Prison.
timeline.quote: Mangara pinned the mage and sealed him in the Amber Prison.

citation.text: "Mirage War", section "The Cost of Hope". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jolrael regrets feeding Kaervek's hunger for power.
timeline.quote: I regret feeding Kaervek's hunger for power

citation.text: Spirit Link (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jolrael confesses she has seen the horrors Kaervek freed and her betrayal is certain.
timeline.quote: I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed.

citation.text: Nekrataal (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek tells a victim the memory of their existence will fade.
timeline.quote: The memory of your existence will fade like the final stars of morning.

citation.text: Psychic Transfer (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek says decay is ripening and denies sustenance.
timeline.quote: You'll gain no sustenance from this harvest.

citation.text: Ashen Powder (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek declares that the weak should be killed or ignored.
timeline.quote: If it is weak, either kill it or ignore it.

citation.text: Enfeeblement (Ninth Edition, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir out of Dominaria, with Kaervek's prison; years later the prison is shattered and Kaervek escapes.
timeline.quote: Kaervek's prison had been shattered, allowing him to escape

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek leaves Zhalfir through an Omenpath after the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Kaervek used one to leave the plane

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disconnected from the Temporal Anchor, Teferi ends up in Zhalfir, finds only a decade had passed and reconnects with Sidar Jabari and Queen Wezna.
timeline.quote: He reconnected with Sidar Jabari and Queen Wezna and found that Kaervek had escaped his Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Found and returned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Mirage Wars, panther warriors are led by Purraj, an ally of Kaervek.
timeline.quote: During the Mirage Wars , they were led by Purraj , an ally of Kaervek

citation.text: "Cat", section "Cat-folk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jabari and the recruits reach Aku and learn Kaervek has escaped and General Mageta is wounded.
timeline.quote: Kaervek has escaped,

citation.work: Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone
citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | Alone" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi finds himself in Zhalfir, now a pocket plane, and recommits to fighting the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: he had arrived in Zhalfir

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Zhalfir found". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Annie sees through the illusions hiding Kaervek and Umezawa in their cells and Eriette frees them.
timeline.quote: Kaervek was on one side of the room; Satoru Umezawa was on the other.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaervek reports that the artifact is not Thran or Phyrexian, and warns it could unleash another Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: You could be unleashing another Phyrexia on the Multiverse.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaervek works on breaking the door's ward.
timeline.quote: Orange flames wove around his fingers, prodding and testing the protection spell.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The ward breaks and Oko and Vraska descend, leaving the crew behind.
timeline.quote: He turned for the door without remorse, disappearing down the stairs with Vraska close behind.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko returns to the Wildcard Saloon and tells the crew that Vraska and Ashiok betrayed them.
timeline.quote: "Vraska and Ashiok were always planning to double-cross us.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko disbands the crew with the promise of a future reunion, deciding to leave Kellan and Annie alone.
timeline.quote: "No. From now on, their business is their own,"

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 6: The Ballad of Thieves and Thunderslingers" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie and Eriette break Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa out of the Sterling Company's cells.
timeline.quote: As they broke the ancient warlock and the ninja free from their cells

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew enters the vault; Annie finds the security grid and Akul and the Hellspurs arrive.
timeline.quote: Annie used her enhanced eyesight to search for traps

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Thunder Junction, Oko recruits Kaervek for a heist on Maag Taranau; he is imprisoned by the Sterling Company and broken out by Eriette and Annie Flash.
timeline.quote: Eriette and Annie Flash broke them out

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek analyzes the vault key and warns that opening the vault may unleash a malevolent force akin to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: cautioned that opening the vault may unleash a malevolent force akin to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Tarnation, Kaervek disables the wards on the vault; it opens and benefactor Jace takes an infant creature and vanishes with Vraska as the vault collapses.
timeline.quote: the heist's benefactor revealed himself to be Jace Beleren

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Insulted that Oko cannot pay, Kaervek warns him of dire consequences if Jace and Vraska are not found.
timeline.quote: Kaervek was insulted and warned Oko

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashiok hires Oko for a heist of Maag Taranau, and they gather an outlaw crew.
timeline.quote: he was contacted by Ashiok and hired to perform a heist to steal the contents of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Satoru and Kaervek are imprisoned by the Sterling Company.
timeline.quote: Later, they were both imprisoned by the Sterling Company

citation.text: "Satoru Umezawa", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eriette and Annie Flash break Kaervek and Satoru out; Satoru stays to help secure the key.
timeline.quote: Kaervek escaped while Satoru stayed back to assist Oko

citation.text: "Satoru Umezawa", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Asmira sees an early harvest as an omen of war and warns Femeref's theocracy, but few believe her.
timeline.quote: Asmira saw this as an omen of war and warned the theocracy of Femeref, but there were but few who believed her.

citation.text: "Asmira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek summons the Spirit of the Night, which slaughters the Council of Voices in Tulumai; Asmira is propelled to power.
timeline.quote: When the people of Femeref discovered the monster had slaughtered the council, they realized Asmira had been right all along and she was immediately propelled to power as their successor.

citation.text: "Asmira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Asmira is appointed Sidar of the Femeref armies and leads them against Kaervek's forces.
timeline.quote: Asmira was appointed Sidar, Zhalfirin for general, of the Femeref armies.

citation.text: "Asmira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi sends visions to Jamuraa, and Asmira leads the expedition to recover the imprisoned Mangara.
timeline.quote: She led the expedition to recover Mangara, whom Kaervek had imprisoned in an Amber Prison , from the Mwonvuli .

citation.text: "Asmira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Breathstealers aid Kaervek's attempt to conquer Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: The Breathstealers aided the dark mage Kaervek in his attempt to conquer

citation.text: "Breathstealers", section "Activities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eriette joins Oko's gang on Thunder Junction and helps break out Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa.
timeline.quote: Eriette joined the criminal gang that Oko put together at Ashiok's behest.

citation.text: "Eriette", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hakim tells a tale rooted in a dream from Teferi that makes Kaervek's besieging armies vanish while the civilians escape Tefemburu.
timeline.quote: The tale wove a spell that caused the dark armies besieging the city to vanish completely at dusk

citation.text: "Hakim Loreweaver", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jabari led the Zhalfirin armies in defending Tefemburu after Sidar Mwigo fell, destroying Kaervek's primary army.
timeline.quote: led the armies in defending the city of Tefemburu after Sidar Mwigo fell at Ufunguo

citation.text: "Jabari", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi's experiments phase his isle out of the present; Jolrael meets Mangara and Kaervek there.
timeline.quote: everything on Teferi's Isle was phased out of the present

citation.text: "Jolrael", section "Mirage wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Manipulated by Kaervek, Jolrael declares war on Mangara, then realizes the truth and attacks Kaervek at sea.
timeline.quote: She rebelled and attacked Kaervek while they were sailing in the Kukemssa Sea to Teferi's Isle

citation.text: "Jolrael", section "Mirage wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi sinks Kaervek's armada and sends a drake to rescue Jolrael; she retreats to the Mwonvuli after Kaervek loses.
timeline.quote: Though Teferi sank Kaervek's armada, he sent a drake to rescue Jolrael from the wreckage.

citation.text: "Jolrael", section "Mirage wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Mirage Wars Ki'pamu stands as a stronghold of Zhalfirin resistance against Kaervek and withstands attacks by Jolrael's dragons.
timeline.quote: Ki’pamu was a stronghold for Zhalfirin resistance against Kaervek

citation.text: "Ki'pamu", section "Mirage Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mageta is badly wounded when Kaervek's Amber Prison shatters but survives; Sidar Jabari takes over the army.
timeline.quote: Mageta was badly wounded when Kaervek 's Amber Prison shattered, but he survived.

citation.text: "Mageta", section "Alive". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mangara researches Teferi's Isle and joins Kaervek and Jolrael.
timeline.quote: he joined the two other mages that had been attracted by the event

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Mirage War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek twists Mangara's peacemaking into signs of an army, ensnaring Jolrael.
timeline.quote: Kaervek's machinations ensnared Jolrael

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek and Jolrael trap Mangara in the Amber Prison.

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Asmira and Rashida free Mangara, who with Quirion and Mundungu allies traps Kaervek in the Prison.
timeline.quote: Mangara was able to turn the tide and trap Kaervek in the Prison

citation.text: "Mangara", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaervek relocates to Jamuraa and manipulates Jolrael into a war; Purraj oversees infiltration of the Mwonvuli and Uktabi jungles.
timeline.quote: Purraj helped oversee an infiltration of both the Mwonvuli and Uktabi jungles.

citation.text: "Purraj", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Purraj supervises the invasion of Femeref and Zhalfir and guards the Amber Prison holding Mangara.
timeline.quote: was a guardian of the Amber Prison

citation.text: "Purraj", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rashida amasses an army and fights Kaervek's undead, slaying almost a dozen dragons and becoming a legend.
timeline.quote: Slaying almost a dozen dragons, Rashida soon became a legend for the common people

citation.text: "Rashida Scalebane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rashida leads her army against Kaervek and joins an expedition that recovers Mangara with the Dragon Mask.
timeline.quote: joined an expedition to recover Mangara

citation.text: "Rashida Scalebane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, disguised as Ashiok, hires Oko to retrieve the vault's contents with a crew of outlaws.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren , disguised as Ashiok , hired Oko to retrieve the contents of Maag Taranau

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
